lines.l: Hello, my brother. How you doing? I'm holding up.
I'm just packing to go to my mum's.
But I just wanted to check on you, girl, to see how you're doing.
Remember, stay positive, it's not forever
It'll be over before we know it
Creased white shirt, dancing like somebody's dad
Bouncing around with the girls on a Saturday night
I'm not saying stay the same, just these don't ever change
Cause after everything you've been through
You still make me laugh like no one else does
Your mind and body bare scars
You've been to hell and back
When I'm howling at the moon
My tummy hurts and I can't breathe
There's nowhere else I'd rather be
Or just watching TV with a takeaway
